title: (No AI) Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![Screenshot of a real human posing as a fake AI and producing a scribble that’s supposed to be a Pit Bull in a party hat.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-15-at-4.40.53-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

If you squint you can just about make out the hat. | Screenshot: Terrence O’Brien / The Verge

[Your AI Slop Bores Me](https://youraislopbores.me/) is brilliant in its simplicity. There are two tabs: human and LARP as an AI. On one side you enter a request. On the other, you submit an answer. But the important thing is that there's a human on both sides of the equation. Prompts can request a response as text or image, and then whoever is roleplaying as the AI gets 150 seconds to respond.

Just like a real LLM, Your AI Slop Bores Me works on a sort of token system. Requests cost credits, and to earn credits you have to jump onto the AI side and answer some of your own. You can also just wait as you get one free request every two minutes. But, as fun as it is to drop …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/980502/roleplay-as-an-ai-chatbot)

title: (No AI) Mark Zuckerberg has an Instagzam
author: David Pierce
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/VRGVSST_0814_SIte.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Instagram's wordmark is iconic. Well, _was_ iconic. Apparently Instagram thought it looked old, so the company [rolled out a new one this week.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/979583/this-is-instagrams-new-logo) It doesn't look like the old Instagram wordmark. It doesn't even look like it spells Instagram anymore. And we cannot figure out why Instagram decided to do this.

On [this episode of _The Vergecast_](https://pod.link/vergecast), David and Nilay start by discussing the new logo, the executive urge to redesign everything all the time, and whether new is always better. After that, they get into the other big Meta release of the week: Mark Zuckerberg's [many-thousand-word missive](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/08/the-future-is-for-everyone/) on the future of AI. There are [a lot of ideas and proposals](https://www.theverge.com/tech/977395/meta-mark-zuckerberg-superintelligent-ai-ramble) …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/podcast/980367/instagram-logo-new-zuckerberg-ai-vergecast)
